**Key Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- George Russell has 262 championship points after 20 races (source: RacingNews365, Sky Sports F1)
- Max Verstappen has 279 points (source: RacingNews365, Sky Sports F1)
- Gap: 17 points with 3 races remaining
- Three remaining races: Las Vegas (Nov 22), Qatar, Abu Dhabi
- Maximum points available per race: 26 (25 for win + 1 fastest lap)
- Maximum remaining points: 78 — Russell can mathematically overtake Verstappen
**Supporting Facts (MEDIUM confidence):**
- Mercedes' car has historically performed well at Las Vegas (high-speed, smooth tarmac)
- Russell won at Las Vegas in 2024 (single source, needs secondary verification)
